name: flodesk
description: Flodesk shared MCP and task CLI for current subscribers, native batch upserts, draft campaigns, workflows, custom fields, webhooks and exact reviewed account work.
long_description: Shared native subscriber/draft/workflow/custom-field/webhook tasks with mandatory local approval and exact account-profile review. Official OAuth analytics/cohort MCP remains separate.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute private token-only file. Select oauth in the authentication-type field only for a partner Bearer token; otherwise it defaults to an API key.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse mutations and private output file writes.

api_key.title: Private account API key
api_key.description: Flodesk private integration key, HTTP Basic with an empty password. Choose this OR the optional OAuth access token, never both.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed mutations
allow_destructive.description: Permit mutation execution only when the tool call explicitly confirms the exact action. Disable to refuse all mutations.

access_token.title: External OAuth access token (optional)
access_token.description: Use this OR an API key, never both. Partner tokens expire; this bundle does not sign in or refresh them.

auth_type.title: Token-file authentication type (optional)
auth_type.description: Enter oauth only when the selected token file contains a partner Bearer token; otherwise leave blank for API key.
